_comment: Weaviate schema for SMART RAG. Placeholder __COLLECTION_NAME__ is replaced by scripts/bootstrap.sh with the value of WEAVIATE_COLLECTION_NAME from .env. All collections use vectorizer 'none' — embeddings are generated externally by the ingest pipeline and stored as object vectors (provider-agnostic).

classes.description: Per-student learning record. Populated by n8n UserMemory Summary workflow. Cross-agent: one record per user, updated as the student progresses.

properties.name: course_id
properties.description: Which course this object belongs to (COURSE_ID in .env). One installation can host several courses; every retrieval filters on this, so an object without it is invisible to every agent.

properties.name: user_id
properties.description: Stable student identifier (from LTI sub or LMS user id)

properties.name: concepts_mastered
properties.description: Concepts the student has demonstrated mastery of

properties.name: concepts_struggling
properties.description: Concepts the student has had difficulty with

properties.name: open_questions
properties.description: Unresolved questions from prior conversations

properties.name: learning_patterns
properties.description: Free-text summary of how the student tends to learn

properties.name: summary
properties.description: High-level summary of the student's overall progress

properties.name: last_updated
properties.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the most recent update

properties.name: chapter
properties.description: Last topic/chapter the student was active in

classes.description: Generic key-value store for n8n workflows (last-run timestamps, cursors, flags).
Knowledge-test results per session — populated by the knowledge-test agent (e.g. agent 13).

properties.name: course_id
properties.description: Which course this object belongs to (COURSE_ID in .env). One installation can host several courses; every retrieval filters on this, so an object without it is invisible to every agent.

properties.name: selected_topic
properties.description: Topic the student chose to be assessed on

properties.name: difficulty
properties.description: Difficulty level reached (easy/medium/hard)

properties.name: tasks_summary
properties.description: Short summary of tasks given and how the student answered

properties.name: sections_to_review
properties.description: Course sections the student should revisit

classes.description: All chat messages across all agents. Vector field is computed by the ChatHistory sync workflow (n8n) using the configured embedding provider. Used for cross-session, cross-agent semantic recall.

properties.name: course_id
properties.description: Which course this object belongs to (COURSE_ID in .env). One installation can host several courses; every retrieval filters on this, so an object without it is invisible to every agent.

properties.name: agent_id
properties.description: Which agent this message belongs to (1..N)

properties.name: role
properties.description: 'user' | 'assistant' | 'system'

properties.name: message_index
properties.description: Order within session (0, 1, 2, ...)

properties.name: message_hash
properties.description: Stable dedup key

properties.name: trace_id
properties.description: Langfuse trace id, if available

properties.name: message_type
properties.description: Custom classification (question, answer, meta, etc.)

classes.description: Course content chunks (course materials, transcripts, papers, etc.). Class name is templated — replaced by bootstrap.sh with WEAVIATE_COLLECTION_NAME from .env. Vectors are computed by the ingest pipeline using the embedding provider configured in .env.

properties.name: course_id
properties.description: Which course this object belongs to (COURSE_ID in .env). One installation can host several courses; every retrieval filters on this, so an object without it is invisible to every agent.

properties.name: text
properties.description: The chunk content itself

properties.name: doc_type
properties.description: e.g. 'course-material', 'transcript', 'paper', 'slide-deck'

properties.name: parent_chapter_title
properties.description: Higher-level chapter, if nested

properties.name: section_id
properties.description: Stable identifier for the section (e.g. '2.3', 'unit-04', etc.)

properties.name: section
properties.description: Section title or heading

properties.name: section_type
properties.description: e.g. 'introduction', 'theory', 'example', 'summary'

properties.name: effect_size
properties.description: Optional: for evidence-based content (e.g. Cohen's d from meta-analyses)

properties.name: speaker
properties.description: For transcripts: who is speaking

properties.name: ts_start
properties.description: Audio/video timestamp — start of chunk

properties.name: ts_end
properties.description: Audio/video timestamp — end of chunk

properties.name: chunk_index
properties.description: Order within source document

properties.name: chunk_total
properties.description: Total chunks for the source document

properties.name: chunk_hash
properties.description: Stable dedup key

properties.name: source_title
properties.description: Human-readable name of the source document

properties.name: source_file
properties.description: Original filename in MinIO

properties.name: bucket
properties.description: MinIO bucket the source came from

properties.name: type
properties.description: Free-form type tag (e.g. 'core', 'supplementary')

properties.name: topic
properties.description: Topic/concept tag — used by agent topic filtering

properties.name: agent_id
properties.description: Which topic agent this chunk is primarily relevant for
